era5.source: ECMWF ERA5 via the Open-Meteo archive API, land grid cell, Asia/Kolkata civil days

cmip6.source: CMIP6 HighResMIP daily precipitation via the Open-Meteo climate API, statistically downscaled and bias-corrected to ERA5-Land at about 10 km
cmip6.scenario: HighResMIP projections through 2049, described by Open-Meteo as the high-resolution CMIP6 runs closest to RCP8.5. Scenario spread is small before 2050, and this is not a full SSP ensemble.
cmip6.biasCorrection: Linear monthly bias correction onto ERA5-Land. The climate-change signal is retained.
